answer: Re-attestations are stored in saffron and yarrow lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the crystal graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2827 identities would post 2719 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
